data.title: What happened to the food

memoryNodes.cue: Each entry names a source of food.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 每条记录指出食物来源。

memoryNodes.cue: Food has been left by another animal.

data.situation:
A feeding record lay on the next table. In one clip, a predator followed its prey; the scene showed a carnivore hunting for food. Another clip showed a herbivore feeding on leaves. Jo then opened a photograph of an omnivore beside a note about the different foods it ate. At the end of the film, a scavenger fed on remains left by another animal. Maya traced each meal back to its source on the record. Jo: Is every animal in the film hunting?
Ruth: No. Look at how it gets food, not just whether it eats meat.
Maya: So this scavenger is feeding on what was left?
Ruth: In this clip, yes. An animal may feed in more than one way.

readingBlocks.en: A feeding record lay on the next table. In one clip, a predator followed its prey; the scene showed a carnivore hunting for food. Another clip showed a herbivore feeding on leaves. Jo then opened a photograph of an omnivore beside a note about the different foods it ate. At the end of the film, a scavenger fed on remains left by another animal. Maya traced each meal back to its source on the record.
readingBlocks.zh: 下一张桌上放着取食记录。片段里，捕食者追踪猎物，展示肉食动物猎食。另一片段里，草食动物吃叶。乔打开杂食动物照片，旁边说明它吃的不同食物。影片结尾，食腐动物吃另一只动物留下的残骸。玛雅追溯每顿食物的来源，在记录上追踪。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: Is every animal in the film hunting?
Ruth: No. Look at how it gets food, not just whether it eats meat.
Maya: So this scavenger is feeding on what was left?
Ruth: In this clip, yes. An animal may feed in more than one way.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：片中每只动物都在捕猎吗？
露丝：不是。看它怎样获得食物，不只看是否吃肉。
玛雅：所以这只食腐动物在吃留下的东西？
露丝：在这个片段里是这样。动物可能有多种取食方式。

glossary.zh: 捕食其他动物的动物；捕食者
glossary.note: 动物义；掠夺者社会义未计。

externalEvidence.definition: any animal that lives by preying on other animals

glossary.zh: 被其他动物捕食的动物；猎物
glossary.note: 本例名词，常不可数；prey on动词未计。
glossary.example: The prey moved away through the grass.

externalEvidence.definition: animal hunted or caught for food

glossary.zh: 主要吃肉的动物；肉食动物
glossary.note: 食性分类；并非每次都主动猎杀。
glossary.example: The clip showed a carnivore hunting.
glossary.exampleZh: 片段展示肉食动物猎食。

externalEvidence.definition: any animal that feeds on flesh

glossary.zh: 主要以植物为食的动物；草食动物
glossary.note: 与取食行为连接，不凭单次观察断定所有食性。

externalEvidence.definition: any animal that feeds chiefly on grass and other plants

glossary.zh: 吃植物也吃动物性食物的动物；杂食动物
glossary.example: The note described an omnivore’s varied food.
glossary.exampleZh: 说明描述杂食动物的多种食物。

externalEvidence.definition: an animal that feeds on both animal and vegetable substances

glossary.zh: 吃死亡动物等残余物的动物；食腐动物
glossary.note: 动物义；拾荒者、化学清除剂等未计。
glossary.example: A scavenger fed on the remains.

externalEvidence.definition: any animal that feeds on refuse and other decaying organic matter
